lock_note: Created before any held-out run. The lock pins the SHA-256 of benchmark/thresholds.json. The same threshold hash is recorded in every result artifact under results/committed/*.json (field thresholds.sha256). No implementing-commit SHA is recorded by this lock: locked_at_commit stays null until an owner sets it at release time.
policy: A change to benchmark/thresholds.json after this lock invalidates the held-out evaluation; it requires an explicit issue update before the next held-out run.
